newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins GSM expansion from UK Cellnet.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins GSM expansion from UK Cellnet.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in statement on Tuesday it would deliver an expansion to UK mobile phone network operator Cellnet in a deal valued "in the region of 100 million stg."
The deliveries to expand Cellnet's digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) would take place until the end of 1998, Nokia said.
It would supply base station controllers and modular digital base stations, enabling Cellnet to increase network coverage and capacity.

Cellnet the mobile phone arm of British Telecommunications Plc, already has a network of 2000 radio sites. Of its 2.7 million customers in the UK, over 1.4 million are connected to its digital service.
"By the end of 1998, Cellnet will have 3,000 radio sites," Nokia said.
